text: Beauty gained about 13,600 new reviews since yesterday, roughly five times any other category, led by a cocoa butter lotion combo, a Bombay Shaving Company razor and Mamaearth face wash, with health and kids' wear next. For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best: a ₹91 fridge cover gained 490 reviews, and jewellery sets stay light, cheap and low on complaints.

headline: Women's ethnic: everyday kurtis lead, bandhani sarees are moving
text: Kurtis have the most reviews overall, and a ₹295 kurta and a ₹201 kurti gained the most since yesterday (+133 and +126). Among sarees, shimmer and bandhani designs are climbing as Diwali (8 November) and Chhath approach, and new bandhani listings appeared today. The typical price is about ₹291 and about 9% of reviews are 1-star. Sellers are mostly in Gujarat and Rajasthan, so price competition is strong. Free-size sarees are an easier start than sized kurtis.

headline: Women's western: simple shirts and tank tops sell, jackets are rising
text: A ₹194 women's shirt gained the most reviews since yesterday (+265), followed by a ₹294 girls' jacket (+208), an early winter signal. Tank tops at about ₹165 are steady sellers and lead the category overall. The typical price is about ₹290, with about 7% 1-star reviews, which is lower than most clothing here. Delhi and Gujarat sellers lead. Sizes still mean returns, so start with a small range.

headline: Men's clothing: slowest daily growth, and the most complaints
text: This category gained the fewest new reviews since yesterday (about 250), mostly on shirts priced ₹248 to ₹392. New hoodie and winter sweatshirt listings keep appearing, so the season is starting, but none of them is among the big sellers yet. It has the highest 1-star share of any category at about 12%, which points to quality complaints and returns. The typical price is about ₹326, and Delhi, Rajasthan and Tamil Nadu sellers lead. It is not a good first category unless you have a reliable supplier.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap sets and winter socks are moving fast
text: Kids gained the third-most new reviews since yesterday (about 2,360). A ₹136 top-and-bottom set leads, and winter socks and sweaters are climbing with the weather. The typical price is low at about ₹183, so margins are thin, and about 9.5% of reviews are 1-star. Toys such as the ₹80 magic practice book have no sizes, which makes them the easier way in. Gujarat and Delhi sellers lead.

headline: Home & kitchen: a ₹91 fridge cover is today's standout
text: A ₹91 fridge cover gained the most reviews since yesterday (+490), followed by sticky wall hooks, evil-eye wall hangings and agarbatti, all cheap and useful. Cotton wicks and tealight candles are among today's new listings just before Diwali on 8 November, but it is very late to start festive stock now. The typical price is about ₹155 and about 7.5% of reviews are 1-star, with wall hooks lower at about 6%. These items are light and have no sizes, which suits a beginner. Gujarat, Haryana and Delhi sellers lead. This category had 34 usable products today.

headline: Beauty: most daily growth by far, but brands own most of it
text: Beauty gained about 13,600 reviews since yesterday, far more than any other category, led by a cocoa butter lotion combo (+2,159), a Bombay Shaving Company razor and Mamaearth face wash. Most top sellers are brands, and reselling them usually needs the brand's authorisation, while making your own cosmetics needs a licence. Unbranded tools such as a ₹94 silicone back scrubber (+868) are the realistic entry. The typical price is about ₹175, with about 8% 1-star reviews. Haryana, Maharashtra and Gujarat sellers lead. This category had 31 usable products today.

headline: Jewellery: steady, light and ahead of wedding season
text: Jewellery sets lead the category, and a ₹142 rhodium set gained the most since yesterday (+226), along with bracelets and ring combos. Total daily growth is modest at about 580 reviews, the second-lowest of any category. New bridal-style listings such as bangle sets and 1-gram gold sets appeared today, which fits the wedding season starting later this month. The typical price is about ₹166, and about 7% of reviews are 1-star. Items are very light with mostly no sizes, so shipping and returns stay easy; Gujarat and Maharashtra sellers lead.

headline: Bags & footwear: wallets and handbags move steadily
text: A ₹114 men's wallet gained the most reviews since yesterday (+87), with women's flip-flops, backpacks and shoulder bags close behind. Its listing uses the BMW name, so don't copy that: use plain designs with no brand names. Handbags remain the largest type overall, with about 7% 1-star reviews, the same as the category. The typical price is about ₹191. Bags and wallets have no sizes while footwear does, so start with bags; Delhi sellers lead.

headline: Electronics: phone holders are growing, earbuds draw complaints
text: Phone holders and stands took four of the top five growth spots since yesterday, along with a wooden Bluetooth speaker. Many earbud listings are being added, but earbuds and headphones have about 15% 1-star reviews, nearly double the 8% on phone holders. The typical price across the category is about ₹341, while holders sell for about ₹82 to ₹134. If you try this category, start with holders and stands, not earbuds. Delhi, Gujarat and Haryana sellers lead.

headline: Health & fitness: branded basics lead, ear-lobe patches keep selling
text: Health gained the second-most new reviews since yesterday (about 2,720), led by Dabur toothpaste and Stayfree and Everteen pads, which a beginner can't easily resell without authorisation. Ear-lobe support patches at about ₹68 are the unbranded-style item that keeps selling (+283 on the top one). New football and cricket listings show sports demand. It has the lowest 1-star share of any category at about 5.6%, and the typical price is about ₹237. Delhi, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh sellers lead.

Fridge covers, today's standout home mover at about ₹91.
Sticky wall hooks, about ₹100, with the lowest complaints of these ideas at about 6%.
Jewellery sets and bangle sets, for the wedding season starting later this month.
Silicone back scrubbers, about ₹94, an unbranded beauty item that gained 868 reviews.
Ear-lobe support patches, about ₹68, a low-priced health seller.
Phone holders and stands, about ₹82 to ₹134, with far fewer complaints than earbuds.

Avoid for now: earbuds and men's clothing (most complaints), sized clothing in general (returns), branded beauty and pads (need authorisation), anything using a brand name you don't own, and Diwali-only stock (too late to start).
